facts.fact: Douglas 被绑在空浴缸里过夜（四肢+嘴胶带），像翻不过身的乌龟
facts.anchor: got dropped into an empty bathtub to writhe around all night like a turtle stuck on its own back.

facts.fact: 他承认并非完全无辜：知道 Sandra 让他紧盯 Bethany、CEO 侄子 Kyle 卧底参与
facts.anchor: He knew that Bethany was part of some secret special project, that the CEO’s nephew Kyle was undercover and involved in it too.

facts.fact: 凌晨三点左右、挣脱手腕胶带、完全自由、有清晰逃生路径
走到后门时改变主意（cold feet）；思考为何犹豫——怕被杀或无法想象旧生活
facts.anchor: Maybe he simply can’t imagine his old life anymore.

facts.fact: 他大喊求助、却要求 Jules 重新绑回自己：「I didn't try to escape. I've got Stockholm syndrome」
facts.anchor: “I didn’t try to escape. I’ve got—what’s it called—Stockholm syndrome.

facts.fact: Jules 重绑时他想套近乎（goth vs regular person），被再贴胶带封嘴
facts.anchor: I feel like you and I got off on the wrong foot. But I actually think we might not be as different as you might assume.

facts.fact: Jules 夜里反复回放停车场威胁 Bethany 的一幕、后悔太刻薄（self-sabotage）
facts.anchor: They regret being so harsh. It was total self-sabotage, because they know that deep down they want to be on good terms with Bethany.

facts.fact: Lubbock 那几天是 Jules 一生最刺激时光；敲门无人应
facts.anchor: The time they spent together down in Lubbock—though only a few days—was probably the best, most exciting time in Jules’s entire stupid life.

facts.fact: David 被敲门声叫醒；Jules 说「We've got a problem」
